More critically, the Planner did not fully capitalize on the clarity of the first search result to establish a firm baseline before moving to the second band, potentially setting a precedent for less rigorous data extraction. While the error is subtle, the Planner's analysis was less precise than the raw data available, failing to explicitly confirm the "USA" status in the "Updated Understanding" section with the same confidence as the source text, which could have led to confusion when conflicting data appeared for the second band. This lack of precise data extraction and confirmation in the initial step is the root cause of the subsequent ambiguity handling issues.
